labels: One student supports a notebook from below while a second student's fingers close around its opposite edge, both hands contacting the same notebook.; 한 학생이 공책 밑면을 받치고 다른 학생의 손가락이 반대 가장자리를 감싸 두 사람의 손이 같은 공책에 닿는다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: One student supports a notebook from below while a second student's fingers close around its opposite edge, both hands contacting the same notebook.
aliases: 물건 전달의 겹친 소유
